candidates.snippet: Trump: "Ukraine has not received advanced weapons from the U.S. because it lacks the necessary platforms to use them."

Military journalist Sergiy Auslender, citing sources, reports that an assassination attempt was made near Kyiv against the head of Fire Point, Denys Shtilerman. 

Shtilerman himself stated, "the rumors of my death, or the death of my bodyguards, are greatly exaggerated." https://
